---
title: "Execute the Pipeline"
subtitle: "Keep rendering and scientific execution separate"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

The graph inventories staged paths and dynamically branches the approved W3
CSV preparation work. Branching is declared here rather than in the notebook:
the notebook defines one-file transformation logic, while this graph defines
dependencies and the scheduler can distribute independent branches.

::: {.callout-warning title="W3 final aggregation stopping point"}

The current graph executes each per-file maximum in DuckDB and writes the
result to a branch-specific Parquet file. `targets` stores those file paths
rather than attempting to serialize live duckplyr relations. The final
cross-file DuckDB aggregation is not yet declared here.

:::

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Execution Boundary"}

The runtime image and frozen R package library must exist. Approved inputs must
be staged under `data/raw`. Rendering the Manual is not pipeline execution.

:::

:::: {.emit-source-r file="{{ emit.project_root }}/_targets.R"}
::: {.manual-procedure title="Emit The Targets Graph"}

```r
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)

tar_option_set(
  packages = c(
    "duckplyr", "tibble", "here", "readr", "cli", "glue", "purrr", "stringr", "dplyr"
  )
)

list(
  tarchetypes::tar_tangle(
    "notebooks/pipeline/16_page-stage-inputs.qmd"
  ),
  tarchetypes::tar_tangle(
    "notebooks/pipeline/18_page-prep-w3.qmd"
  ),
  tar_target(
    clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_csv_path,
    pipeline_raw_input_files_paths %>%
      str_subset("RMA_W3_FULL")
  ),
  tar_target(
    clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_within_file_group_max_df,
    process_csv_safely(
      clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_csv_path,
      file.path(
        "data/intermediates/RMA_W3",
        paste0(tar_name(), ".parquet")
      )
    ),
    pattern = map(clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_csv_path),
    format = "file"
  )
)
```

:::
::::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-script-sh file="{{ emit.project_root }}/scripts/run-pipeline.R" mode="0755" title="Emit The Pipeline Entry Point"}

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

script_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE), value = TRUE)
script_path <- if (length(script_arg)) sub("^--file=", "", script_arg[[1]]) else ""
if (!nzchar(script_path)) {
  stop("Could not determine the pipeline runner path.")
}

repository_root <- normalizePath(
  file.path(dirname(script_path), ".."),
  mustWork = TRUE
)
setwd(repository_root)
targets::tar_make()
```

:::

Run the graph explicitly:

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr run scripts/run-pipeline.R
```

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Initial Graph"}

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript -e \
  'stopifnot(all(c("pipeline_raw_input_files_paths", "clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_csv_path", "clinic_raw_data_RMA_W3_within_file_group_max_df") %in% targets::tar_manifest()$name))'
```

:::
